target.title: fix(mcp): suppress unhandled rejection from async gateway event handler
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The MCP channel bridge onEvent callback calls `void this.handleGatewayEvent(event)` without `.catch()`. The handler is async and has no internal try/catch — if it rejects, the unhandled promise rejection crashes the process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `.catch(() => {})` to suppress the unhandled rejection. The `handleHelloOk` callback on the next line already has internal try/catch so it does not need the same treatment.

## User Impact

MCP channel bridge no longer crashes on unexpected gateway event handler rejections.

## Evidence

**Before**: `void this.handleGatewayEvent(event)` — async handler without catch → unhandled rejection → crash

**After**: `void this.handleGatewayEvent(event).catch(() => {})` — rejection suppressed

## Risk

Low. One `.catch(() => {})` addition. The same pattern is used elsewhere in the codebase (e.g. `gateway?.stopAndWait().catch(() => undefined)` in the same file at line 210).
